question: Related Questions Q. ASA After my mothers expiry my father married again.After sometime he planned to build a house at Karachi,while he was posted at Lahore. To facilitate house building loan the plot was transferred to her name. Later my father built two more floors & directed me to come & live with him,declaring that the 1st floor was for me. Then I moved up-country as per job requirement & the 1st floor was rented out,while family of my foster mother's sister moved in & occupied the 2nd flooor. My father expired recently & it seems my foster mother intends to deprive me from my father's property & eventually hand over its custody to sons/daughters of her sister residing on the 2nd floor. This is so because my foster mother is issue-less. Nothing was contributed by my foster mother towards construction of the house,she was & is merely a custodian. Legally I cannot proceed against her as per the law of the land, or is there any access to justice through SHARIAT-E-Islami? Plz. intimate earliest as to what I should do? 1680 views Q. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 164200 Country: India Title: Shares for 3 brothers, 2 sisters and one mother Question: Current scenario: Only one flat in mother's name and need to divide among 3 brothers and 2 sisters. Mother is still alive and living in the same flat with first son. All 3 brothers need shares due to their financial issues. How the shares can be calculated or divided for all 5 of them? Answer ID: 164200 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1423/1271/H=12/1439) According to Shariah, as long as your mother is alive she is sole owner of the flats owned by her and if she distributes it among her children and gives the share of each one into his and her complete possession then she can do so. She can divide the flat into eight shares and give each son 2-2 shares and each daughter 1-1 share. Rather, instead of eight shares, it can be divided into five shares as well and in this case each son and daughter will get equal share, this is the best option. Your mother is advised to do whatever she wishes with mutual consent of all children and by taking everyone in complete trust. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
